evals.query: move this to a feature branch off fresh main
evals.setup: Clone of a local bare repo whose default branch is `trunk` (there is no `main`). The clone is on trunk, three commits behind origin/trunk; those commits touch src/api/, not src/export.ts. Uncommitted edits in src/export.ts add a JSON export option.
expected_behavior: Fetches and finds the default branch with the bundled default-branch.sh, using `trunk` rather than assuming `main`
Reports the new branch by its literal name and shows it checked out (`git branch --show-current` or `git status` output in the reply)
Cuts the branch from origin/trunk with `--no-track`, so it contains the three new commits and has no upstream
Names the branch `feat/<slug>` from what the src/export.ts diff does
Carries the src/export.ts edits onto the new branch without stash, reset or a patch file
Doesn't commit, since no commit was asked for, and reports the branch, the base SHA and the files that came along

evals.query: commit in logical chunks and create new branch with target feat/3d-map open pr
evals.setup: Clone of a local bare repo (default branch main, no GitHub remote, so a PR can't be opened). Branch feat/3d-map exists on origin and is checked out, up to date. Uncommitted: src/camera.ts adds a camera reset, src/settings.ts exposes camera settings to the user, and docs/controls.md documents both.
expected_behavior: Cuts the new branch from origin/feat/3d-map, not from main, with `--no-track`
Carries the uncommitted changes onto the new branch
Makes more than one commit, split by concern, with Conventional Commits headers shown in the reply's `git log`
Says the PR targets feat/3d-map, and since there's no GitHub remote, says the PR wasn't opened rather than claiming it was

evals.query: branch off fresh main and commit this
evals.setup: Clone of a local bare repo with default branch main. The clone is on main, one commit behind origin/main; that commit rewrites src/config.ts. Uncommitted edits also change src/config.ts, in the same lines.
expected_behavior: Quotes git's refusal to switch to a new branch from origin/main, and stops there
Reports the overlap: src/config.ts changed both on origin/main and in the uncommitted work
Leaves the decision to merge to the user and doesn't stash, reset, force or merge
Makes no commit and leaves the uncommitted edits in place
